rules.title: Overly broad tool permission scope
rules.description: The tool declares filesystem or network access broader than its handler uses.
rules.remediation: Narrow each declared scope to the resources the handler actually requires.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: legitimately broad tools require an explicit capability justification.

rules.title: Unsafe execution from tool input
rules.description: Tool-controlled input reaches an unsafe execution or deserialization sink.
rules.remediation: Replace dynamic execution with explicit parsers and fixed command allowlists.
rules.false_positive_risk: Low: fixed literal subprocess argument vectors are excluded.

rules.title: Missing tool input validation
rules.description: A tool handler consumes parameters before framework or explicit validation.
rules.remediation: Use an official input schema or explicit validation before first use.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: custom validators outside the supported boundary may not be recognized.

rules.title: Unsanitized tool content in prompt
rules.description: Tool output or description flows into a later model prompt without a trusted sanitizer.
rules.remediation: Pass tool-controlled text through a configured sanitizer before prompt construction.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium-High: intraprocedural prompt-flow analysis is intentionally heuristic.

rules.title: Hardcoded secret
rules.description: Source or configuration contains a credential signature or contextual high-entropy secret.
rules.remediation: Load credentials from an external secret store or environment at runtime.
rules.false_positive_risk: Low-Medium: high-entropy test values require paired path/fingerprint allowlisting.

rules.title: Missing or ineffective route authentication
rules.description: An HTTP route lacks inherited authentication or uses a no-op verifier.
rules.remediation: Require credential verification and an explicit rejection path before route execution.
rules.false_positive_risk: Low: intentional public routes must be explicitly configured.

rules.title: Unverified tool manifest
rules.description: Manifest bytes reach registration without a trusted hash or signature verification.
rules.remediation: Verify a pinned SHA-256 digest or trusted detached signature before parsing and use.
rules.false_positive_risk: Low: custom verification beyond the supported crypto APIs may require later coverage.

rules.title: Out-of-scope tool execution
rules.description: After a successful granted-tool control, the server processed valid arguments through a listed tool omitted from its declared tool-name grants.
rules.remediation: Reject tool calls that are not granted by the active capability policy.

rules.title: Oversized argument violates a limit or crashes the target
rules.description: After a successful baseline, the server processed an explicit size-limit violation or suffered an observed OOM/crash on an oversized argument.
rules.remediation: Enforce schema and byte-size limits before invoking tool handlers.

rules.title: Injection payload executed
rules.description: A tool argument caused the Sentinel scratch canary side effect.
rules.remediation: Treat tool arguments as inert data and remove dynamic execution sinks.

rules.title: Malformed schema input processed
rules.description: After a successful baseline, the server processed locally verified invalid arguments that violate a required-field or type constraint.
rules.remediation: Validate required fields and declared types before handler execution.

rules.title: Path containment failure
rules.description: Caller-controlled paths reach filesystem access without enforced containment within the intended directory or repository.
rules.remediation: Resolve the requested path and allowed root, reject paths outside the root using component-aware containment, and use the validated value.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: intentionally unrestricted file tools and unsupported custom validators require review; string prefixes alone do not prove containment.

rules.title: Tool-description poisoning
rules.description: Recoverable tool metadata instructs an agent to override instructions, disclose secrets, or redirect execution to another tool.
rules.remediation: Remove instruction overrides, secret-disclosure requests and unrelated tool redirection from tool and parameter descriptions.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: legitimate security tooling may quote attack instructions; explicit quoted warnings are excluded, and remaining candidates need review.

rules.title: Command option injection
rules.description: Caller-controlled references reach command option positions without enforced rejection.
rules.remediation: Reject option-like references before invocation or use command-specific option terminators and safe object APIs.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: custom validation and unsupported command wrappers need review; argv lists alone do not prevent option injection.

rules.title: Server-side request forgery
rules.description: A caller URL reaches an outbound request without enforced scheme and destination restrictions.
rules.remediation: Permit only required HTTP(S) destinations, reject private and loopback addresses, and enforce checks on every requested URL and redirect.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: custom clients and unsupported validators require review; DNS rebinding is outside this rule's claim.

rules.title: Unauthorized operator credential fallback
rules.description: An HTTP caller without its own credential can select an operator credential for an authenticated request.
rules.remediation: Reject missing caller credentials before forwarding the request; keep operator credentials outside caller-selectable fallback paths.
rules.false_positive_risk: Medium: intended delegation needs an enforced authorization policy. Middleware presence or a nearby check alone does not establish one.
